description: [Cairo] Public Transport Terminals is a data set listed in Transport Data Commons (Transport Data Catalogue), a transport data catalogue, published or maintained by Transport for Cairo. The terminal polygons layer identifies locations where vehicles serving a route assemble, functioning as both the starting point and final destination for public transportation services. These terminals include formal facilities as well as informal gathering areas, such as certain street corners. Coverage: Egypt. The portal files it under the publisher Transport for Cairo. Its tags are Cairo, Egypt, Greater Cairo Region, Popular Transport, Public Transport. It offers 2 resource(s) in GEOJSON, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-tdc-portal.
